name: setup-defer
description: Record or clear the deferral of an optional Setup extra. Use when the operator wants to leave an optional extra for later. Required steps cannot be deferred: they block Start onboarding. Deferred extras show as 'deferred' on the next setup-status call — never as done. Use action 'resume' to clear a deferral.

inputs.task_id: string (the id of an optional extra from setup-status, e.g. 'google_workspace', 'web_research', 'working_style')
inputs.action: string ('defer' to skip a task, 'resume' to un-skip it)

outputs.deferred: string[] (full updated list of deferred task ids after this operation)
